$comment: A9 Protocol v11 deployment parameters (testnet). Source of truth for values: ops/config/testnet.params.json (production timing) or ops/config/testnet-fast.params.json (fast-cycle drill). This file is the contract-side summary used by contracts/scripts/deploy-emulation.tolk defaults; keep it in step with ops/config. No TeamVault / OracleAdapter / rewardV2 (removed in v10/v11). Addresses are produced by the deployment, never typed here.

price.note: target = max(P0 * 2^tier, 2 * opening 24h TWAP), locked at open; ladder R10 = 118784000 USD_E8

timingFastCycle.envOverride: A9_TIMING_PREVIEW_SECONDS / A9_TIMING_STAKE_SECONDS / A9_TIMING_CANDLE_SECONDS / A9_TIMING_CANDLE_COUNT / A9_TIMING_MIN_QUALIFIED / A9_TIMING_ABORT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS

stakingLimits.note: v11: no per-address cap and no round cap

stakeTicket.note: one ticket per (owner, round); address derived from RC + owner + round + code

junxiangDistributor.fundingRule: not funded at deploy; ops funds the distributor jetton wallet with >= the cumulative total BEFORE each junxiang-set-root
junxiangDistributor.note: cumulative Merkle model (contracts/README §7.1); no admin, no withdrawal

roles.keeper: A9_KEEPER_ADDRESS (writes RC initial data; cannot be changed)
roles.junxiangPublisher: A9_JUNXIANG_PUBLISHER_ADDRESS (default keeper; writes distributor initial data)

addresses._: filled by deploy-emulation.tolk into contracts/deploy/*.addr and ops/config/testnet.registry.json

deployOrder: 1. Deploy JettonMaster, MintOnce 100 亿 to treasury (same transaction closes minting)
2. Deploy RoundController (keeper, jettonMaster, teamWallet, params, JettonWallet + StakeTicket codes)
3. Verify RC.get_jetton_wallet_address == JettonMaster.get_wallet_address(RC); RC.get_ticket_code_hash == StakeTicket build
4. treasury -> RC: 82 亿 A9 with forward_ton_amount = 0
5. Deploy JunxiangDistributor (publisher = junxiangPublisher, codes = JettonWallet + ClaimRecord); verify get_distributor; NO funding
6. Fund TON gas (RC >= 20 TON, keeper >= 2 TON); treasury distributes internal sale 8 亿 / liquidity 5 亿 / marketing 5 亿
8. weekly junxiang: fund distributor wallet >= cumulative total, then publisher SetRoot(listId, root)
